img_986.description: Shuffled tiles of a circular diagram: naked female figures holding eight-pointed stars, text labels in rings, and in several tiles a red crustacean-like creature with legs and claws, one tile with a green-and-red creature.
img_986.central_figure: a red crayfish- or crab-like animal with claws and legs
img_986.sign_reason: red clawed, many-legged crustacean in the centre tiles

img_279.description: Shuffled tiles: red-painted figure in an arched tower or basket-like structure, red drapery, star with hand, ring text, and a tile with a red horned animal head over green ground.
img_279.central_figure: a red horned animal (bull-like) on green ground, with towers and robed figures around
img_279.sign_reason: red animal head with long horns standing on green, similar to the bull in img_247

img_593.description: Shuffled tiles: many naked female figures in tubs or rings with stars, blue garments in a few tiles, and one tile showing a drawn bow or crossbow.
img_593.central_figure: a figure in blue holding a crossbow
img_593.sign_reason: crossbow/bow visible in a centre tile with blue-clothed figure

img_725.description: Shuffled tiles: a woman in a long blue-striped dress, a man with a green hat and green garment, plus naked figures holding stars and ring text.
img_725.central_figure: two clothed figures, a woman in blue and a man in green
img_725.sign_reason: a clothed couple (male and female) rather than an animal

img_886.description: Shuffled tiles: red and blue barrel-like tubs with figures, a figure with red cap holding a star, a green sprig, and a pale four-legged animal with hooves and a curly/fleecy underside on green ground.
img_886.central_figure: a pale four-legged hoofed animal, possibly a ram, on green ground
img_886.sign_reason: hoofed quadruped with fleecy outline; no clear horns seen, so uncertain

img_801.description: Shuffled tiles: many naked figures with stars and ring text, and tiles with a dark green creature with a looping tail and clawed feet.
img_801.central_figure: a green lizard- or salamander-like creature with a curled tail
img_801.sign_reason: green reptile-like creature with curling tail, the usual stand-in for the scorpion in this diagram style

img_768.description: Shuffled tiles: two scaly fish with fins and blue tinting, a curved hatched band (ring), stars, and text labels.
img_768.sign_reason: clearly scaled fish with fins, more than one

img_743.description: Shuffled tiles: a woman in a blue robe with a blue headcloth, a hand holding a small flower, naked figures, stars and ring text.
img_743.central_figure: a robed woman in blue, apparently holding a flower
img_743.sign_reason: single clothed female figure with a flower, no animal

img_878.description: Shuffled tiles: a goat head with curved horns and green body, basket-like tubs, figures in tubs holding stars, a green-clad figure, water-like blue outline.
img_878.central_figure: a horned goat with green-brown body

img_408.description: Very faded shuffled tiles: an animal with furred or feathered body and blue speckles, a clawed or beaked head, a red dot, figures and ring text; hard to make out.
img_408.central_figure: a faded animal, possibly a lion or other furred beast
img_408.sign_reason: image too faded and fragmented; furry animal shape is suggestive of Leo but not decisive

img_541.description: Shuffled tiles: naked figures with stars, a vertical post with a horizontal beam and hanging blue pans, ring text.
img_541.sign_reason: upright post with crossbeam and pans

img_247.description: Shuffled tiles: a red four-legged animal with horns on green ground, naked figures in tubs holding stars, ring text.
img_247.sign_reason: red horned bovine body with stout legs

recognise_source: yes - the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), recognised from the script and the nude figures with stars in tubs
